addition.item: Channels: notifications to Slack, Microsoft Teams (Workflows), Discord, Telegram and a generic JSON webhook with optional HMAC signature; selectable events and a test button.
Administrator dashboard module with core status, update counts, security findings and health warning.

change.item: Webhook URLs and tokens are masked in the options and never logged; chat messages neutralise mentions from untrusted extension names.

addition.item: Statistics tab: time to fix per severity (median, average, longest, share within target), open updates and their age, oldest open updates, last 6 months.
Remediation targets in days per severity; overdue updates are marked in the update list.
Version jump (major, minor, patch) next to the available version on the dashboard, in the update list, in the history and in emails.
Median time to fix on the dashboard and in weekly and monthly reports.
Dashboard banner when scheduled checks stop running, with likely causes (disabled plugin or task, missing task, scheduler not triggered, stuck task, last run failed).

change.item: Only checks started by the Scheduled Tasks plugin count for this warning; manual checks and the check on opening the component do not hide a broken cron job.

addition.item: Security checks tab: installed extensions are compared with the Joomla Vulnerable Extensions List (also when no update exists).
End-of-life check for PHP, the database server and Joomla.
Blind spots: extensions without update server, with a disabled update server or with a server that was not checked recently.
Disabled extensions that have a pending update are reported.
Email about new vulnerable-extension and end-of-life findings; red dashboard banner for vulnerable extensions.
Option for detailed error messages (file and line) in the activity log; off by default.

change.item: Changelog XML containing a DTD or entity declaration is rejected.
The configured site URL is only used for mail links if it is an http(s) address.
Logged errors no longer include file names and line numbers unless the debug option is on.

addition.item: Joomla update server support: the package can now be updated through the Joomla installer.

change.item: Hardening: only http(s) links are accepted from update data, changelog URLs must resolve to public addresses, redirects are validated, downloads are size- and time-limited, changelogs are parsed without XPath, auto-check on open is throttled.

fix.item: The activity log no longer warns about update server packages that are not installed.

addition.item: Check when the component is opened (never sends mail).
Separate options for emails after manual and scheduled checks.
Link to the Joomla extension update page on the dashboard.

change.item: Check result message is green without updates and yellow with updates.
Joomla Core is shown separately on the dashboard and in emails.
Emails list new updates first and all other open updates below.

fix.item: Database writes failed silently, so history and log stayed empty.
